title: docs(changeset): date-note six pending entries that PRs #10793, #10802 and #10821 made false (objectui#10877)
body:
Fixes #10877
Clause-②: no. It is release-text hygiene, and no published type or behaviour moves.

## What this does

Eight pending changesets each state a contract fact that a later PR in this same unreleased batch made false: PR #10793 (objectui#7924, `densityMode` retired), PR #10821 (objectui#7928, `ObjectViewSchema.listViews` mirrored by reference, a named view's `options` bag refused whole) and PR #10802 (objectui#10770, `ObjectChartSchema.series` became two arms). A pending changeset publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG at the next release, and the release PR objectui#5400 is still open. So each false sentence now has a dated supersession note beside it.

The note form is copied from the landed precedents, PR #10533 (the `6235-mergedsort-wrap.md` note) and PR #10828 (objectui#10801): a bold headline naming the date and the card whose change supersedes the sentence, then what holds now, then the superseding entry by file and PR, then "the text above is kept as the reading of this change".

- Zero lines deleted: `git diff --numstat` against the merge-base `9f0c84a448` is 168 insertions, 0 deletions, over 8 files. The first round added 10 notes in 6 files. Patch round 1 added 4 notes in 2 files (below). Patch round 2 edited the 7779 note and added none, so there are 14 notes.
- The frontmatter is byte-identical in all nine entries the claim and its addendum `5862987983` name. The md5 of the frontmatter block is equal at the merge-base `9f0c84a448` and the head `50deccd71a` for each: 7924-retire `ecedb10c`, 8355 `8f322642`, 10321 `564c93d5`, 10584 `84f96a9a`, 8365 `379475b3`, 9242 `acef2a2c`, 8086 `e927372d`, 7779 `ecedb10c`, 7946 `2ffd8635`.
- The seventh entry, `8086-chart-series-type-arm.md`, is untouched (whole-file md5 `7ea6b544` at base and head). Every sentence in it measured STILL-TRUE (see the lit control below).
- No new changeset: the diff is `.changeset/` only, and `check-changeset-presence` says none is owed.

| Entry | FALSE-NOW sentences, quoted | Superseding entry (PR) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `7924-named-list-view-retire.md` | "`NamedListView` (one entry of `ObjectViewSchema.listViews`)"; "Two bucket-③ members are NOT retired" and "They stay declared as they were." | `7928-listviews-by-reference-fold.md` (#10821); `7924-density-mode-through-fold.md` (#10793) | 2 |
| `8355-retire-calendar-date-aliases.md` | "it now names the key and the remedy on all five authoring surfaces", for "a named view's two nestings under `listViews`"; "plus a `.check()` on `ObjectViewSchema` for a named view's two nestings"; "`ObjectViewSchema.listViews` stays UNMIRRORED" and the rest of that paragraph; "`timeline.dateField` stays a live, accepted alias", on a named view; "the structural guard that `listViews` stays out of the object's `shape`" | `7928-listviews-by-reference-fold.md` (#10821) | 3 |
| `10321-named-view-kanban-groupby-refused.md` | "`ObjectViewSchema.listViews` is unmirrored"; "and in its legacy `options.kanban` bag" with the issue path under `options.kanban`; "reports one issue per written key, naming the key and the replacement"; "Not changed, deliberately: `listViews` stays unmirrored" and the rest of that paragraph | `7928-listviews-by-reference-fold.md` (#10821) | 2 |
| `10584-object-chart-series-describe.md` | "It now says the copy is that `{ dataKey }` arm minus its per-series `type`, and that the per-series family override on an `object-chart` node is `chartType`"; "taking `type` up would widen a published accept set" | `10770-object-chart-react-tier-node.md` (#10802) | 1 |
| `8365-stray-kanban-groupby-refused.md` | "objectui#10321 gives that route its own door, which refuses the key in either nesting with the same message" | `7928-listviews-by-reference-fold.md` (#10821) | 1 |
| `9242-stray-kanban-groupby-lane-second-route.md` | "which refuses the key in either nesting with the same message"; "(a named view's `kanban` is typed as the `list-view`'s), but not the key inside the untyped `options.kanban` bag on either" | `7928-listviews-by-reference-fold.md` (#10821) | 1 |
| `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md` (patch round 1) | the table's "still unmirrored"; "`listViews` stays unmirrored, on the ruling's own fallback clause."; "The declaration's value is the local `NamedListView`"; the 21-read / 43-unread figures; "The key therefore stays in the parity ledger … until the maintainer decides its value type" | `7928-listviews-by-reference-fold.md` (#10821) | 1 |
| `objectchart-schema-anchor-7946.md` (patch round 1) | the `series` half of "value types taken from their READ sites (`ChartRendererProps` for `xAxisKey` / `series`)" and of "two are INTERNAL, relay-composed (`xAxisKey`, `series` …)"; "`series` entries must be `dataKey`-shaped."; "`aggregate` is the exception, and only because the spec's own object is strict." | `10770-object-chart-react-tier-node.md` (#10802) | 3 |

**Placement.** Each note sits directly after the paragraph that holds the false sentence. Where two false paragraphs are adjacent, one note covers both: the first 10321 note, the 10584 note and the last 8355 note. The 8355 note after the UNMIRRORED paragraph also covers the matching clause in the `@object-ui/types` bullet above it, because both describe the same named-view check. No note cites a line address; source facts are cited by symbol and test name, and `check:new-line-citations` reads 0 new citations.

## Measured, not inherited (one-time probes, not committed)

The probes ran the worktree sources at base `b2683a2c0e`, with `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 resolved from `packages/types`. The zod face ran through `tsx`, and the TS face through `tsc --noEmit` against `packages/types/src/index.ts`. Each probe sits beside a control that differs only by the key. A named view is `listViews.v` with `columns` set.

Zod face (`ObjectViewSchema.safeParse`; `safeValidateSchema` gives the same issues on the two `kanban` rows):

| Probe | Result |
| --- | --- |
| control `kanban: { groupByField, columns }` | parses |
| `kanban.groupBy` | two issues: `unrecognized_keys` at `listViews.v.kanban` naming `groupBy`, and `custom` at `listViews.v.kanban.groupBy` |
| `options: { kanban: { groupBy } }` | one issue: `unrecognized_keys` at `listViews.v` naming `options`; nothing at the `options.kanban.groupBy` path |
| `calendar.dateField` | `unrecognized_keys` at `listViews.v.calendar`, and `custom` at `listViews.v.calendar.dateField` |
| `options: { calendar: { dateField } }` | one issue: `options` refused |
| `timeline.dateField` | `unrecognized_keys` at `listViews.v.timeline`; control `timeline: { startDateField, titleField }` parses |
| each of the 16 retired `NamedListView` spellings, and `densityMode` | `unrecognized_keys` at `listViews.v` naming the key (17 of 17); control `userActions: { search: false }` parses |
| `listViews` in `ObjectViewSchema.shape` | present |
| list-view route: `kanban.groupBy`, `options.kanban.groupBy`, `calendar.dateField`, `options.calendar.dateField`, `timeline.dateField` | `invalid_type`, `custom`, `invalid_type`, `custom`, parses: unchanged |

TS face (`tsc`):

| Probe | Result |
| --- | --- |
| named view `kanban.groupBy` in an `ObjectViewSchema` literal | TS2353, excess property on the spec's kanban block |
| named view `options` | TS2353, `options` does not exist |
| named view canonical control | compiles |
| `list-view` `kanban.groupBy` | TS2322 (`never`): unchanged |
| `list-view` `options.kanban.groupBy` | compiles: unchanged |
| a `NamedListView` value as a `listViews` entry | TS2322, not assignable |
| `NamedListView` with `densityMode`; with `allowExport` | TS2322; compiles |

Chart series (`ObjectChartSchema.safeParse`): `{ name, type: 'line' }` parses with `type` kept; `{ dataKey, type: 'line' }` parses with `type` stripped; `{ name, chartType }` is refused (`invalid_union`). The series `.describe()` string now names both arms.

The runtime fold was read, not probed: `normalizeListViewSchema` still folds `densityMode` and the eight `show*` flags, and `ListView` still merges `options.kanban` under `kanban`.

## Lit control: STILL-TRUE, left byte-identical

- `8086-chart-series-type-arm.md`, the whole entry. PR #10802 changed no `plugin-charts` source (its one file there is a test). `ChartRendererProps.schema.series` still declares `type?: string` on both arms. The `ObjectChartSchema.series` docblock still says the copy of the internal arm omits `type`, and that internal arm's type is the same literal as before PR #10802.
- 8365, "takes the identical message through a check on that untyped bag", and the distinguishing `options.kanban` fixture. Both are the `list-view` route, measured unchanged.
- 9242, "a `list-view` document carrying the key, under `kanban` or under the legacy `options.kanban` bag, is refused by `safeValidateSchema`". Measured unchanged.
- 8355, the `@object-ui/types` bullet's "on the legacy `options.calendar` nesting (a check, since an open record declares no member". This is the list-view surface, measured unchanged.
- 7924-retire, "`densityMode` is folded onto `rowHeight` by `normalizeListViewSchema`" and "Only the authoring face changes". The fold still does both.
- 10584, "Wording only. The accepted shape does not move on either face". This is a statement about that change's own delta, and it is still true of that change.
- 7779 (patch round 1): `viewTabBar` retired; the eight keys enforced; "64 declared top-level members"; the spec record requires `columns` and refuses `options`, tuple filters and `default`; "not papered over with `z.any()`"; "absent stays valid on all nine"; the ledger move 14/96 → 14/87 (that change's own delta). Each measured true at `0ea55c3701`.
- 7946 (patch round 1): the `xAxisKey` half of the INTERNAL sentence (its `.describe()` still says all five producers compute it); `type: 'object-chart'` required; `chartType` must be the declared union; `normalizeChartSchema` translates the `{ name }` arm; `aggregate` `function` / `groupBy` required with unknown members refused; a misspelled key on the node itself is not refused; `filter` keeps both arms. Each measured true at `0ea55c3701`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Residue in the same family: closed by patch round 1.** The first round stopped on two files outside the claimed surface, `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md` and `objectchart-schema-anchor-7946.md`. Each is named by a superseding PR itself. The seat extended the file surface (addendum `5862987983`, option A), and patch round 1 (`80ee15eecb`) added one note to 7779 and three to 7946, in the same form and measured the same way. `Fixes #10877` stays.
  - **For the at-tier review.** The last 7946 note also names two changes outside the three PRs: `drillDown` (objectui#8885, PR #8895) and `xAxis` / `yAxis` (objectui#10518, PR #10601). Both landed after the 7946 entry, and both also make its "`aggregate` is the exception" sentence false. That sentence of the note can be dropped if the review holds it out of scope; the rest of the note stands without it.
  - Not measured: the wider pending population that names `listViews` / `NamedListView` or `ObjectChartSchema`. Only the entries the superseding PRs name were read.
- **Source prose. These are observations and were not filed; carrier: none.**
  - The `ObjectChartSchema.series` TS docblock (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`) says "A `type` written on this arm anyway is an excess property on a literal typed by this interface." Since PR #10802 that is false. `{ dataKey: 'amount', type: 'line' }` compiles in an `ObjectChartSchema` literal, because the union's `{ name }` arm declares `type` (tsc probe above). The zod mirror still strips it.
  - The zod docblock headed "WHERE THIS ARM IS INSTALLED — TWO ROUTES, TWO NESTINGS EACH, ONE STRING" (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`) still says a named view's `listViews` "is unmirrored", and it still names a `custom` issue under `options.kanban` on that route. The docblocks of `checkNamedViewKanbanStrayGroupBy` and `namedViewKindRefusals` are current.
- **A dispatch premise, corrected.** "Each one already states in its own body that it supersedes the older entry" holds for `7924-density-mode-through-fold.md` and `7928-listviews-by-reference-fold.md`. `10770-object-chart-react-tier-node.md` names no superseded entry. The supersession is stated in PR #10802's body ("Superseded pending changesets"), which names the objectui#10584, objectui#7946-anchor and objectui#8086 entries.
- **`main` merged, twice.** `origin/main` `4f38f39286` was merged as `0ea55c3701`: the two merged commits touch none of the probed sources, and the probes re-ran byte-identical. `origin/main` `9f0c84a448` was merged as `bade176fff` (patch round 2), which carries `35d68c4c` (PR #10884, objectui#10758). That merge moved probed sources (`objectql.zod.ts`, `objectql.ts`, `ChartRenderer.tsx`); the probes re-ran at `50deccd71a`, byte-identical to round 1's head outputs. Neither merge used a rebase or a force-push.
- **Patch round 2 (at-tier record `5864532186`, FAIL on one note).** The 7779 note said the renderer reads 20 members and leaves 44 unread. That was true at `4f38f39286`, but PR #10884 re-took the census to 43 / 21 on `main`. Per the seat's decision (REWORK `5864543090`), the note now states no figure. It says the split is no longer the 21 / 43 the entry counted, names both changes that moved it (objectui#7928 and objectui#10758), and cites the census pin in `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`, which re-derives the figures on every run (`43 read + 21 unread = 64` at the head). No other note moved.
- **The headline card.** Each note's headline names the card whose change supersedes the sentence, as the PR #10533 notes did. PR #10828's notes named their own card instead, because the cause there was a spec release that has no pending entry.
- **Commit trailers are model-free** (`Co-Authored-By: Claude`), per the dispatch. The harness offered a trailer that carries a model name, and it was not used.
